risk_if_not_implemented: Without Sensitive / Regulated Data On Hosted Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), cloud-hosted Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may be misconfigured, over-exposed or governed inconsistently with on-premises controls. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), Uncontrolled Third-Party Security / Privacy Exposure (R-GV-5), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Third-Party Management
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of third-party management controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Third-Party Management (TPM-02) provides third-party oversight that compensates for the absence of Sensitive / Regulated Data On Hosted Assets, Applications & Services (CLD-12.2) by extending security obligations contractually and monitoring third-party risk in lieu of direct control. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Hosted Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to specify applicable security, compliance and resilience that must be implemented on external Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), consistent with the contractual obligations established with the External Service Providers (ESP) owning, operating and/or maintaining external TAAS.
compensating_control_2.justification: Hosted Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) (CLD-12) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Sensitive / Regulated Data On Hosted Assets, Applications & Services (CLD-12.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
